verdict.rationale: Amplitude's own docs reference a versioned ingestion endpoint (HTTP V2), which shows some API versioning exists. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or versioning across its other APIs. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning scheme across Dashboard/Export/Taxonomy/Experiment APIs, changelog or sunset timelines, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Send data directly from your server to the HTTP V2 endpoint.
